pull_requests.title: Enforce Idempotency-Key on charge and refund endpoints
pull_requests.head: li/idempotency-keys
pull_requests.body:
Implements PAY-118.

- POST /v1/charges and POST /v1/refunds now return 400 `idempotency_key_required` when the header is missing
- Keys are persisted in `idempotency_keys` with a 24h TTL
- Replays return the stored response verbatim

Tested against the Brightcart sandbox.

reviews.body: Approved. This closes the double charge hole from INC-2026-014.

pull_requests.title: Switch amounts to integer minor units
pull_requests.head: tomas/amount-minor
pull_requests.body: Implements PAY-122. `amount` (decimal string) becomes `amount_minor` (integer) across the API and the ledger. Adds `CHECK (amount_minor >= 0)` on `ledger_entries`. Currency now travels in a separate `currency` field (ISO 4217).

reviews.body: LGTM, ran the contract tests against staging.

pull_requests.title: chore: add ledger snapshot export
pull_requests.head: tomas/snapshot-export
pull_requests.body: Adds the `ledger-snapshot-export` CronJob at 02:15 UTC. See Finance.

reviews.body: Approving, but we should document this.

comments.body: What does Finance do with this file, and where does it get written?
Not totally sure on the details, Noah's team asked for it. Please don't change the schedule or they'll page me.

pull_requests.title: Per-merchant rate limiting (Postgres token bucket)
pull_requests.head: maya/rate-limit-pg
pull_requests.body:
Implements PAY-142.

Adds a `rate_limit_buckets` table and does the token-bucket check in a single `UPDATE ... RETURNING` per request. Default is 100 req/s per merchant, overridable in `merchant_limits`.

Redis is NOT used in this PR. Adds ~2ms p99 per request in load tests.

reviews.body: LGTM. I thought we decided on Redis in #payments-eng though?

comments.body: We did. Postgres for now, Redis later. Didn't want to block the Brightcart launch.

pull_requests.title: Nightly ledger reconciliation job
pull_requests.head: tomas/reconcile-ledger
pull_requests.body:
Implements PAY-163.

Adds the `reconcile-ledger` CronJob (03:30 UTC). It compares ledger entries with the PSP settlement report and opens a Jira ticket for every mismatch above $1.

Owner: @tomas-rivera

pull_requests.title: API versioning via Meridian-Version header
pull_requests.head: tomas/api-version-header
pull_requests.body: Adds the date-based `Meridian-Version` request header. Requests without it default to the version pinned on the merchant account. Removes the unused /v2 router stub.

pull_requests.title: Webhooks: cap retries at 3 with longer backoff
pull_requests.head: tomas/webhook-retry-cap
pull_requests.body: Brightcart told us our retry storms were knocking over their endpoint during deploys. Dropping to 3 attempts with 2s / 10s / 60s backoff. Delivery is still at-least-once; events that fail the 3rd attempt are marked `failed`.

pull_requests.title: Ledger v2 dual-write behind ledger_v2_writes
pull_requests.head: maya/ledger-v2-dual-write
pull_requests.body: Implements PAY-188. Every ledger entry is also written to the v2 tables when the `ledger_v2_writes` flag is on (default: off). Rolling back is just turning the flag off, no migration needed.

reviews.body: Tested with the flag on and off in staging, both paths behave.

pull_requests.title: ledger client: add short-lived service JWTs
pull_requests.head: li/ledger-service-jwt
pull_requests.body:
The mesh sidecar is not injected in the `ledger` namespace yet, so payments-service calls to ledger-service currently go over plain HTTP inside the cluster. This PR adds short-lived service JWTs (HS256, signed with `LEDGER_SVC_KEY`) so ledger can at least verify the caller.

TODO: remove once the mesh is enabled for ledger.

reviews.body: Approved as a stopgap until the mesh is enabled for ledger.

pull_requests.title: Support two active webhook signing secrets
pull_requests.head: tomas/dual-signing-secrets
pull_requests.body:
Allows a `current` and a `next` signing secret so we can rotate without downtime. Merchants verify against either during the overlap window.

Rotation procedure: TODO, will write it up in the runbook.

pull_requests.title: ci: deploy to prod on every merge to main
pull_requests.head: sasha/continuous-deploy
pull_requests.body: Implements PAY-205. Removes the Thursday release train gate and the manual approval step. Merges to main now deploy to prod automatically; risky changes must be behind a feature flag.

issues.title: Flaky ledger integration tests
issues.body: test_ledger_concurrent_writes fails roughly 1 in 10 runs on CI. Looks like a race on the sequence allocation in the fixture, not in prod code.

issues.title: Document the nightly cron jobs
issues.body:
We have two nightly CronJobs (ledger-snapshot-export and reconcile-ledger) and nobody can explain end to end what they do. Needs: purpose, owner, where output goes, who consumes it, and what to do when they fail.
